`reproduce_all()` exposes the standardized source-to-result route. Provider-controlled raw inputs are supplied separately; absent those inputs the function completes frozen local publication parity and reports that public reacquisition requires provider access.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(SIECCLongWeather)
reproduce_all()
```
